كُرْزٌ The [double bag, or double sack, called] خُرْج (ISk, S, K) of the pastor, (K,) in which he carries his provisions and utensils, and which is also put upon the back of the [ram called] كَرَّاز: (TA:) or a جُوَالِق [or sack]: (A, Msb:) or a small جوالق: (TA:) pl. [of pauc.] أَكْرَازٌ (ISd, TA) and [of mult.] كِرَزَةٌ. (S, K.) [See بَطِينٌ.] ―
